query: SELECT t.lead_conversation AS "task!", t.id, t.state, (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_team_members m JOIN conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE m.team_id = t.id AND c.state <> 'deleted') AS "helpers!", (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_team_members m JOIN conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE m.team_id = t.id AND c.state <> 'deleted' AND m.state = 'stuck') AS "stuck!", (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_team_members m JOIN conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE m.team_id = t.id AND c.state <> 'deleted' AND m.state = 'failed') AS "failed!", t.state = 'running' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_messages q WHERE q.channel_id = t.channel_id AND q.type = 'person_question' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_messages a WHERE a.channel_id = q.channel_id AND a.type = 'person_answer' AND a.body->>'question_seq' = q.seq::text)) AS "waiting!" FROM agent_teams t WHERE t.lead_conversation = ANY($1)
